description:
Memorial list for various families. Dating: 13th century. 

Mentions: Yiṣḥaq ha-D[ayyan?]; his son Maṣliaḥ; his son Zekharya; his brother ʿAmram. THe house of Ibn Qasāsa. Nadiv; his brother Yefet; his son Yaʿaqov; his sons Shelomo and Natan. Elʿazar. Shemarya. Sheʾerit and his brother Ṭahor. Elʿazar and Yefet. [There is an interlinear insertion in a different hand here, referring to the wife of Abū ʿImrān.] Sheʾerit; Natan and his brother Elʿazar. His son Petaḥya; Elʿazar; Petaḥya; his son Yeshuʿa; his granddaughter who died. On verso: a family of Kohanim. Yehuda. . . Moshe; his two sons Ṭahor and [...]; Moshe; Yosef; his two sons Ṭahor and Moshe; his son Elʿazar. The house of Ibn al-Dajājī: Netanʾel; Meshullam; Netanʾel; Nadiv; Shela; Hillel; Netanʾel; Yefet; Yosef; [...]; Menashshe. Levis: [...]; his son Meʾir; his son David; his son Netanʾel; his son Ḥalfon; his son ʿAmram; Ḥalfon; Meʾir; Shemuʾel; ʿAmram the scholar (talmid); Yefet; Elʿazar. Yakhin the cantor; his son Elʿazar; his son Yakhin; Saʿadya and Sar Shalom.
description_he: רשימת יזכור למשפחות שונות: קסאסה, דג'אג'י ואחרות. המאה ה-13.
